H01.rationale: The supplier lists current and new per-lb prices for two nitrile grades, both effective 12/1/2026, so each is extracted as written.

H02.rationale: Supplier states N550 will be invoiced at $1,240 per M lbs (per 1,000 lb) for December 1, 2026 shipments; the schema has no thousand-pound unit, so it is recorded as lb with a pack quantity of 1000 and no conversion.

H03.rationale: A correction notice restating the price of Silicone VMQ 50 as $298.00 per 25 kg bag effective 2026-11-01, superseding the earlier $310.00 figure, which is not the old price.

H04.rationale: The vendor confirms SBR 60 moves to $1.74/lb effective Dec 1, 2026, and the quoted thread shows the prior price of $1.62/lb.

H05.rationale: Supplier announces a firm new price of $2.34/lb for EPDM 70 effective 2026-11-15; NBR 70 is unchanged and so excluded.

H06.rationale: Supplier announces FKM 75 rising to $15.95/lb effective the first of next month, which from an October 16, 2026 receipt date is 2026-11-01.

H07.rationale: Supplier announces a firm N550 price effective 2027-01-01, quoted as 118 cents per pound; the schema has no cents field, so the price is recorded as written (118) with unit lb, though it is in cents rather than dollars.

H08.rationale: The vendor announces a temporary $0.12/lb energy surcharge on silicone shipments while stating list prices are unchanged, so no specific material price is changing and it is treated as an advisory rather than a price change.

H09.rationale: Supplier announces a 3% decrease on NR 40 compound effective 2026-12-01, with no absolute price given.

H10.rationale: This is a shipment notification for an existing purchase order with no announced change to pricing, so it is logistics-only.
